intents.name: one-words
intents.description: Single-token commands designed for immediate, semantic triggers without ambiguity.

intents.name: verbose
intents.description: Elaborate, multi-sentence instructions providing deep context, stylistic guardrails, and detailed constraints.

intents.name: dense summary
intents.description: Highly compressed information synthesis that packs maximum semantic meaning into minimal text.

prompts.prompt: A machine learning student realizes their model has been training on the wrong dataset for the last 48 hours.
A middle school student struggles to carry a double bass case onto a crowded school bus without bumping into anyone.
A grocery store clerk tries to keep a pyramid of slippery avocados from collapsing during the Saturday morning rush.
A computer science major stays up all night trying to find a bug, only to realize a missing comma was breaking the code.
A violinist realizes they forgot their rosin just minutes before a recital and has to ask around the orchestra to borrow some.
A group of students spends the weekend manually labeling thousands of photos of cars and trucks for a computer vision project.
A home cook cuts open a large, expensive avocado only to discover the pit is the size of a tennis ball.
A data science student tries to cool down their overheating laptop with a small desk fan while running a heavy simulation.
A beginner drummer practices on a rubber mute pad so they don't wake up their parents in the next room.
A parent tries to convince a picky toddler that the green avocado mash on their toast is actually a delicious treat.
